description.narrative: The Yasuni ITT Trust Fund is established for receipt of contributions from supporters of Ecuador’s historical decision to permanently forego the extraction of the Yasuni ITT oil fields (846 million barrels). The contributions will finance renewable energy and sustainable development investments such as avoidance of deforestation and conservation of ecosystems.
